data_source.query:
FROM kibana_sample_data_logs
| EVAL type = CASE(TO_INTEGER(response.keyword) >= 500, "5xx", "Other")
| STATS count = COUNT(*) by type
| EVAL count_5xx = CASE(type == "5xx", count), count_rest = CASE(type == "Other", count)
| DROP count, type
| STATS count_5xx = MAX(count_5xx), count_rest = MAX(count_rest)
| EVAL percentage = ROUND(count_5xx / TO_DOUBLE(count_5xx + count_rest), 3)
| RENAME percentage as `HTTP 5xx (%)`
| DROP count_5xx, count_rest
